asA: shelf consumer whose Worker fails safe on any Turnstile verification refusal
iWant: a POST to siteverify with the pinned always-fail secret to return success false, the handler to reject with 400, and every event record to carry only sitekeyHash, outcome and timestamp
soThat: the fail branch never leaks the secret or the response token into observability
title: T-5 server-side siteverify fail: the always-fail Turnstile secret returns success:false, the handler rejects 400, and event records carry no token or secret

acceptanceCriteria.description: A live POST to siteverify with secret=2x0000000000000000000000000000000AA returns success:false; the pack-fixture /api/submit handler rejects with 400 whose body carries the error-codes value, not the sitekey. The Node event-secrecy probe asserts that every event record captured on submit carries {sitekeyHash, outcome, timestamp} keys only and does not carry the token or the secret string.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with the pinned always-fail secret in the environment and event-secrecy probe attached
acceptanceCriteria.when: a form submit hits /api/submit and the verifier calls siteverify
acceptanceCriteria.then: siteverify returns success:false, the handler responds 400 with an error-codes body, and every event record carries only sitekeyHash, outcome and timestamp
